message: This token's own variable states no unit, so px was taken from how the library uses it: Radius.radius.control aliases it and is scoped `CORNER_RADIUS`.

The line height is a measured value, but DTCG `lineHeight` is a unitless multiplier of the font size; the measured value is kept under `$extensions["com.spec-layer"]`, and `$value` has no `lineHeight`.
